newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly easier.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly easier.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly softer on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil shed $2.75 a tonne on easier futures. Premiums were steady but trade focussed on arbitrage to the United States and Asia.
Naphtha markets were quiet and prices talked in a wide notional range as buyers and sellers stood apart. Buyers' ideas were $216-217 a tonne cif NWE while offers were around $220.
Gasoline was a touch softer on easier NYMEX but interest to take product transatlantic remained suportive, despite expensive freight costs. Fob barges and cif cargoes valued $225 a tonne.
